summary:
Revised Implementation Plan for the Autonomous PC Control Agent & Dynamic Routing Engine.
Key Enhancements:
1. Per-Phase Model Selection Matrix: Customize which model executes each phase (Phase 1: Clarification, Phase 2: Action Planning, Phase 3: Verification, Phase 4: Error Diagnosis).
2. Multi-Provider Engine: Supports Google Gemini API (2.5 Flash/Pro) and Local Ollama (e.g., Qwen 2.5 3B/7B, Llama 3.2 3B, Phi-3.5) via standard endpoints.
3. UI Model Matrix & Live Connectivity Checker: Real-time ping test for Ollama (http://localhost:11434 with model auto-discovery) and Gemini API, plus quick toggle presets in chat.
4. Auto-runs safe actions, pauses for consequential approvals, and handles errors with in-chat diagnostic cards.
